name: fanbasis
description: FanBasis (rebranded to Commas) is an all-in-one payments and monetization platform providing checkout/funnel builders, subscription billing, and a REST API for collecting payments, managing subscriptions, customers, invoices, discounts, and webhooks.
gating_notes: The consumer product has self-serve signup (commas.com 'Get started' -> /login), but the marketing site groups 'APIs and SDKs' under an 'Enterprise & APIs' section, suggesting fuller API/programmatic access is tied to an enterprise tier. The dedicated developer docs portal at dev-docs.fanbasis.com is login/password-gated, and the API reference content found (via a GitHub mirror of the docs and commasdocs.com) assumes a key already exists, with no visible public self-service key-generation flow documented.
mcp_notes: No official/native MCP server found from FanBasis/Commas itself. A third-party Zapier-hosted 'Commas MCP' exists (mcp.zapier.com) but exposes only inbound event triggers (payment/subscription/dispute events), no action/write tools. The API's own CLI (`commas`) supports agent-friendly `--json` output and `commas tools`/`call <tool>` discovery, per the mirrored docs.
blocker: Unclear self-serve path to obtain a production API key: official docs portal (dev-docs.fanbasis.com) is login-gated, primary docs.fanbasis.com/api docs redirected/were inaccessible without auth, and marketing copy ties APIs/SDKs to the Enterprise tier — so credential acquisition likely requires signup approval or sales contact rather than instant self-serve, even though the REST surface itself (checkout, subscriptions, customers, transactions, webhooks, invoices, discounts, products, disputes) is broad enough to build a rich toolkit.
